_comment: Local place-name alias dataset for the voice-search correction pipeline (lib/core/services/voice_search/place_corrector.dart). Each entry maps ONE canonical, correctly-spelled place name to every spelling a speech recognizer is known to produce for it - typos, dropped/added letters, missing 'ال', a stray 'ل', etc. This file is the only thing you need to edit to teach the app a new neighborhood/street/landmark name or fix a bad transcription - no Dart code changes required, just rebuild the app so the updated asset is bundled. 'category' is free-form and only used for future filtering/telemetry; it is not read by the corrector today. The seed entries below are examples to extend, not a verified gazetteer - add/correct freely.
